page.layout: One column of verb entries running top to bottom, with the lines cut off at the right edge of the scan. No margin notes, no headings. Catchword "Misceo," at lower right.

main_text.l: Attondeo, ich beschäre/ ich schäre ab/ attondi, at-tonsum.
Concieo, ich beruffe zusammen/ich bewege/ con-civi,concitum.
Conniveo,ich zwincke mit den augen/ich sehe durch die finger/connixi,absq; supino.
Despondeo, ich verheisse/ich verzage/ despondi, desponsum.
Deleo,ich tilge auß/ich wische auß/ delevi,deletum.
Frigeo, mich frewrt/ich bin kalt/ frixi, absq; supi-
Gaudeo, ich frewe mich / ich habe lust zum Dinge/ gavisus sum,vel fui gavisum.
Indulgeo, ich verhenge/ich pflege/ indulsi, indul-
Mœreo, ich bin betrübt / ich beweine/ mœstus sum vel fui.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of several lines: "(no." after Fleo, "(tum." after Impleo, and the continuations of "absq; supi-", "indul-" and "at-". Their completions are not visible, so they are transcribed as far as shown. The German glosses are in blackletter and are marked with bl. "klâbe[?]" is uncertain. "Misceo," is treated as a catchword and is left out of the main text.
